subject: Sentinel Inc — MAP & evaluation milestones for GCP/Azure private offers
messages:
From: Alex Moran <alex.moran@sentinelinc.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Apr 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kick-off: private offers (GCP + Azure) & evaluation plan

Hi Ava —

Thanks for the intro call today. As discussed, Sentinel is evaluating Redwood for two private-offer flows: a GCP Marketplace private offer (we'll use a committed PO for Q3) and an Azure private offer for a pilot team. Our procurement lead (procurement@sentinelinc.com) asked for a Mutual Action Plan we can drop into our SOW and procurement tracker so legal/finance can validate timelines.

Key asks from our side: 
- A MAP showing milestone dates for a 4-week technical eval, acceptance gates, and final PO close.
- Confirmation of billing path for the GCP private offer (Marketplace invoice or Redwood invoice + transfer?).
- Any required tax or W-9-like paperwork for US invoicing.

Attached is a quick MAP snapshot we sketched for the internal team (Sentinel_MAP_v0.9.xlsx). It's rough — happy to adapt to Redwood's recommended sequence.

Next steps: can we get a proposed MAP and an initial list of acceptance tests by EOD Monday? Also propose 60-minute technical acceptance demo next week (we prefer Apr 25 morning PT).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

— Alex
Alex Moran
Director, Platform Engineering | Sentinel Inc
alex.moran@sentinelinc.com
Attachment: Sentinel_MAP_v0.9.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moran <alex.moran@sentinelinc.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Apr 2029 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off: private offers (GCP + Azure) & evaluation plan

Alex — great talking yesterday, thanks for the clear asks. Attaching our proposed MAP (RWD_MAP_Sentinel_v1.xlsx) that aligns milestones to your procurement gates and includes the billing path options for both cloud marketplaces. Highlights below: 

- Evaluation sprint (weeks 1–4): sandbox access, perf baseline, and three acceptance prompts + throughput test.
- Acceptance gate 1 (pilot pass): functional acceptance by dev lead + basic perf.
- Acceptance gate 2 (production pass): SLA latency targets and cost baseline verified, then PO issuance.
- Billing path (recommended): for GCP private offer we recommend Marketplace invoicing to Sentinel finance (standard GCP settlement) — this avoids double-invoicing and simplifies tax flow. For Azure we can support a private offer via Azure Marketplace or Redwood invoicing depending on your procurement preference (we've included both flows).

Proposed dates (can shift):
- Sandbox + access: Apr 24
- Tech acceptance demo: Apr 25, 9:30–10:30 PT (propose to confirm)
- Eval complete / acceptance docs to you: May 17
- Target PO date (GCP): May 24

Open items we flagged in the MAP: billing owner (who in your org will accept Marketplace invoices?), PO number format, and any internal acceptance language procurement needs.

If that timeline looks OK, I'll schedule the demo and loop in our finance ops lead for the billing handoff.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com
Attachment: RWD_MAP_Sentinel_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2029 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off: private offers (GCP + Azure) & evaluation plan

Alex — thanks for sharing the MAP. A couple quick notes from pricing/CS side: 

- We can offer a standard enterprise pilot discount for the evaluation period; I'll propose a blended rate and include it in the updated MAP.
- For GCP private offers: the recommended path is to close the private offer via Marketplace (Sentinel accepts invoices from GCP). If your finance team requires Redwood invoices instead, we'll coordinate an invoice handoff and map that into the PO/AR process.

Action items: 
- I'll add a pricing appendix to RWD_MAP_Sentinel_v1 and push back an updated MAP by EOD Wed.
- Can you confirm who in your finance organization will be the billing owner and the preferred PO format? That will speed signing.

Thanks — Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 24 Apr 2029 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kick-off: private offers (GCP + Azure) & evaluation plan

Alex — looping in a couple of legal notes after reviewing the MAP and the potential private-offer flow: 

1) We should confirm which contract governs the private offer: GCP's Marketplace Partner Agreement vs Redwood Master Subscription Agreement (MSA). If Sentinel wants Redwood to invoice directly, we will need a short addendum and a PO flow documented in the SOW.

2) IP/data carveouts: we'll add a standard clause clarifying that inference logs used for caching/optimizations are not retained beyond business needs; will provide language for your privacy/procurement team.

3) Payment terms: default net30; if Sentinel requires net45 or billing via GCP's settlement window, note that in the MAP and procurement checklist.

I've attached a redline with the suggested contract language for the PO route (redwood_po_terms_redline.docx). If Sentinel prefers Marketplace invoicing, legal review is simpler.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood_po_terms_redline.docx (docx)

Hi Ava / Aditya / Karthik —

Thanks for the MAP and the attachments. Quick procurement response: 

- Our target: issue PO for the GCP private offer by May 7. We need the final MAP, acceptance criteria, and the W-9/tax forms attached to the PO packet.
- Billing owner: Finance Ops (Finance Ops Lead: Paula Chen, paula.chen@sentinelinc.com). Please send sample invoice path for both Marketplace invoice and Redwood direct invoice so our AP team can validate.
- Contract: procurement prefers Marketplace invoicing to avoid vendor onboarding in our AR system. If Redwood requires direct invoicing, we'll need the redlined MSA addendum (Karthik's doc) and SOW language.

DocuSign link for pre-acceptance acknowledgment: https://app.docusign.com/sentinel/abcdef123456

We'll schedule a procurement checkpoint on May 2 to finalize any open paperwork.

Thanks — Procurement Team
Sentinel Inc Procurement
procurement@sentinelinc.com
